value.rationale: The 2026 endpoint problem motivates a quantitative global stability constant. Cubic moment-curve extension is the first genuinely nonlinear rearrangement functional. Its sharp global coefficient 5-4/q improves the previously proven general coefficient 3, differs from the local curvature 9-12/q, and is attained at a boundary point, giving a nontrivial structural explanation of near-extremizer stability in all permitted finite fields. The result determines a natural exact invariant rather than an arbitrary finite case; no downstream theorem is necessary.
